Paid usage (partnership ads, Spark Ads) for 90 days, renewable at the next review; the creator keeps ownership.
Category exclusivity for Core only (Chair Side Chats), for the term only.
Every paid post carries the platform's paid-partnership label plus a spoken or written disclosure; the YouTube flag is read every month.
Creators make only the claims listed in the brief.
